subject: Y1
name: Trumbull (gothic stone college, precise architectural watercolor)

styleSelection.reason: Painted value planes carry the form of the stone gable, towers and wings; windows and arches are dry, hard-edged dark shapes; ink only restores structure the wash cannot hold.

families.referenceCue: pale blue sky grading lighter toward the horizon, soft white cloud lights; one connected wet passage, clouds left as paper
warm ochre-tan sandstone, lit faces broad and pale, shaded side planes and towers a darker brown-ochre; irregular coursed blocks, hard edges on dry paper
young street tree, yellow-green mass with light gaps, darker green on the shaded side
